title: CoNP-completeness of recognizing the lexicographically least SAT model
claims: LeastSATModelCheckingCoNPComplete establishes exact coNP-completeness in the pinned model for checking a lexicographically least satisfying assignment.
Comparison is at the first variable occurrence where assignments differ, with false preceding true. Repeated occurrences preserve the order.
The reduction builds a selector-gated formula and always-feasible fallback. The fallback is least exactly when the original input is outside SAT, including malformed inputs.
P_subset_NP is independently checked using pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
